title: Tides Configuration
description: Tide times for a Queensland beach from Maritime Safety Queensland's predictions. Defaults to Woodgate Beach on the Burnett Heads gauge.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Tide Display plugin

gauge.title: Tide gauge
gauge.description: The Maritime Safety Queensland gauge the predictions come from: the dataset name on data.qld.gov.au without '-tide-gauge-predicted-high-low-data'. burnett-heads is the nearest to Woodgate; urangan is Hervey Bay.

time_offset_minutes.title: Time correction (minutes)
time_offset_minutes.description: Added to the gauge's tide times for your beach. Negative is earlier. 0 shows the gauge's own times.

height_offset_m.title: Height correction (metres)
height_offset_m.description: Added to the gauge's heights for your beach.

units.title: Units
units.description: Metres or feet. Heights are above Lowest Astronomical Tide.

display_duration.title: Seconds per Mode
display_duration.description: How many seconds to show each display mode before rotating to the next

show_current.title: Show Current Level Screen
show_current.description: Show the full-display animated water level screen with tide direction and next tides

show_schedule.title: Show Schedule Screen
show_schedule.description: Show today's high/low tide schedule in columns

show_chart.title: Show Chart Screen
show_chart.description: Show the 24-hour tide curve chart with current-time marker

show_stats.title: Show Stats Screen
show_stats.description: Show the moon phase, spring/neap, and tidal range stats screen

show_moon_phase.title: Show Moon Phase
show_moon_phase.description: Show moon phase icon and name on the stats screen

tide_color.title: Water Color
tide_color.description: RGB color for tide water fill [R, G, B]

highlight_color.title: Highlight / Wave Color
highlight_color.description: RGB color for wave crests and chart line [R, G, B]

customization.title: Display Customization
customization.description: Customize fonts and colors for tide text elements. Water and wave colors are set by Water Color and Highlight / Wave Color above.

tide_text.title: Tide Text
tide_text.description: Font settings for the main tide readouts (direction, heights, times, stats). Color applies to neutral text only; high/low and rising/falling text keeps its status colors.

label_text.title: Labels
label_text.description: Font settings for secondary labels (station name, chart time axis, percentages)
